evidence.quote: Northgate Builders Group, a California corporation
evidence.rationale: Preamble names Northgate Builders Group as "Contractor".

evidence.quote: Allied Fire Protection, Inc., a California corporation
evidence.rationale: Preamble names Allied Fire Protection, Inc. as "Subcontractor".

evidence.quote: with Coastal Logistics REIT ("Owner")
evidence.rationale: Recital identifies the Owner under the Prime Contract.

evidence.quote: for construction of the project known as Port of Stockton Warehouse 7, located at 3300 Wharf Access Road
evidence.rationale: Recital identifies the Project.

evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of California
evidence.rationale: Section 17.1 selects California law.

evidence.quote: Contractor's receipt of payment from Owner is not a condition precedent to Contractor's obligation to pay.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2 expressly calls the arrangement pay-when-paid and says Owner payment is not a condition precedent. Section 6.5 on on-site stored materials uses different wording; see anomalies.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within seven (7) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner
evidence.rationale: Section 7.1 states seven days after Contractor receives Owner payment.

evidence.quote: The parties expressly agree in writing that progress payments under this Subcontract are made on a pay-when-paid basis.
evidence.rationale: The contract states a specific 7-day period in writing (7.1), and 7.2 confirms the parties agreed to it in writing.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall withhold retention of five percent (5%) from each progress payment to Subcontractor.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.1 sets retention at 5%, which is 500 basis points.

release_condition.value: (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work, and (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

evidence.quote: within ten (10) days after both of the following have occurred: (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work, and (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.2 lists both conditions. Section 8.3 also requires the final conditional waiver and lower-tier final waivers before release.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall release retention to Subcontractor within ten (10) days after both of the following have occurred
evidence.rationale: Section 8.2 states ten days.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall deliver a conditional waiver and release on progress payment with each Application for Payment
evidence.rationale: Section 9.1 requires a conditional waiver with each Application.

evidence.quote: After receiving each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor an unconditional waiver and release on progress payment covering the amount received.
evidence.rationale: Section 9.2 requires an unconditional waiver for each payment received.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall obtain and deliver to Contractor conditional and unconditional waivers and releases, in the same statutory forms, from each of its sub-subcontractors and suppliers.
evidence.rationale: Section 9.4 requires lower-tier waivers.

evidence.quote: All waivers and releases delivered under this Subcontract shall be in the statutory forms prescribed by California Civil Code Sections 8132, 8134, 8136 and 8138, as applicable.
evidence.rationale: Section 9.3 requires the California statutory forms.

evidence.quote: Contractor may issue any payment due under this Subcontract by check made jointly payable to Subcontractor and any one or more of Subcontractor's suppliers, sub-subcontractors or vendors.
evidence.rationale: Section 10.1 grants a joint check right.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off any Backcharge against any amount owed to Subcontractor under this Subcontract, including progress payments, final payment and retention.
evidence.rationale: Section 11.3 grants backcharge setoff.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold payment for any Subcontract Work that is defective or does not conform to the Contract Documents until that work is corrected and accepted.
evidence.rationale: Section 11.2 permits withholding for defective work. Section 11.1 also covers claims, liens and other listed items.

evidence.quote: Stored Materials are payable under this Subcontract.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.1 makes stored materials payable. Off-site materials require a bonded, insured warehouse and title passing to Owner. On-site materials are covered by 6.5.

anomalies.description: Payment for on-site Stored Materials is made 'subject to' Contractor's receipt of Owner payment. This wording differs from the 7.2 statement that Owner payment is not a condition precedent, and it could be read as a pay-if-paid condition for stored materials.

evidence.quote: Payment is subject to Contractor's receipt of corresponding payment from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Payment for on-site Stored Materials is made 'subject to' Contractor's receipt of Owner payment. This wording differs from the 7.2 statement that Owner payment is not a condition precedent, and it could be read as a pay-if-paid condition for stored materials.

anomalies.description: If Owner fails to pay, the fallback payment period is an undefined 'reasonable time' rather than a stated number of days.

evidence.quote: If Owner fails to pay for reasons not caused by Subcontractor, Contractor shall pay Subcontractor within a reasonable time.
evidence.rationale: If Owner fails to pay, the fallback payment period is an undefined 'reasonable time' rather than a stated number of days.

anomalies.description: Prime Contract terms that are more stringent on Subcontractor govern over this Subcontract unless it expressly states otherwise. This could import different payment terms from a document not attached.

evidence.quote: Where this Subcontract and the Prime Contract conflict, the provision imposing the more stringent requirement on Subcontractor governs, unless this Subcontract expressly states otherwise.
evidence.rationale: Prime Contract terms that are more stringent on Subcontractor govern over this Subcontract unless it expressly states otherwise. This could import different payment terms from a document not attached.

anomalies.description: Applications are due by the 20th but must cover work performed through the end of that month. That includes work not yet performed when the Application is submitted.

evidence.quote: On or before the twentieth (20th) day of each month, Subcontractor shall submit to Contractor an Application for Payment covering Subcontract Work performed through the end of that month.
evidence.rationale: Applications are due by the 20th but must cover work performed through the end of that month. That includes work not yet performed when the Application is submitted.

anomalies.description: Retention release requires Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner. Unlike progress payments under 7.2, there is no statement that Owner payment is not a condition precedent and no fallback if Owner does not release retention.

evidence.quote: (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Retention release requires Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner. Unlike progress payments under 7.2, there is no statement that Owner payment is not a condition precedent and no fallback if Owner does not release retention.

anomalies.description: Final Completion, a release trigger, requires acceptance by Contractor and Owner, which is a discretionary approval. Release also requires final waivers from Subcontractor and its lower tiers (8.3).

evidence.quote: accepted by the authority having jurisdiction, and accepted by Contractor and Owner.
evidence.rationale: Final Completion, a release trigger, requires acceptance by Contractor and Owner, which is a discretionary approval. Release also requires final waivers from Subcontractor and its lower tiers (8.3).

anomalies.description: Contractor may issue joint checks at its sole discretion at any time, not only on the listed triggers. A joint check counts as payment to Subcontractor whether or not Subcontractor endorses it.

evidence.quote: Contractor may exercise this right at its discretion at any time.
evidence.rationale: Contractor may issue joint checks at its sole discretion at any time, not only on the listed triggers. A joint check counts as payment to Subcontractor whether or not Subcontractor endorses it.

anomalies.description: Retention may be applied to any amount Subcontractor owes under any provision of the Subcontract, not only backcharges.

evidence.quote: Contractor may apply retention to any amount Subcontractor owes Contractor under Article 11 or under any other provision of this Subcontract.
evidence.rationale: Retention may be applied to any amount Subcontractor owes under any provision of the Subcontract, not only backcharges.

anomalies.description: Backcharges carry a 15% overhead and profit markup. Under 11.4, Subcontractor must pay any excess of withholding or setoff over amounts due within 10 days of demand.

evidence.quote: Backcharges shall include the actual cost of labor, materials and equipment, plus fifteen percent (15%) for overhead and profit.
evidence.rationale: Backcharges carry a 15% overhead and profit markup. Under 11.4, Subcontractor must pay any excess of withholding or setoff over amounts due within 10 days of demand.

anomalies.description: Withholding rights extend beyond defective work to any other material breach. Contractor may also withhold all subsequent payments until an unconditional waiver is received (9.2).

evidence.quote: (f) any other material breach of this Subcontract.
evidence.rationale: Withholding rights extend beyond defective work to any other material breach. Contractor may also withhold all subsequent payments until an unconditional waiver is received (9.2).

anomalies.description: Contractor may withhold all subsequent payments, not just the related amount, until the unconditional waiver is delivered.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold subsequent payments until it receives the unconditional waiver.
evidence.rationale: Contractor may withhold all subsequent payments, not just the related amount, until the unconditional waiver is delivered.
